map.IIEF-5 勃起功能总分 = 5 题得分之和（Q1 为 1–5 分；Q2–Q5: IIEF-5 total = sum of 5 questions (Q1 scored 1-5; Q2-Q5 scored 0-5, 0 = no sexual activity), max 25; >=22 normal, 17-21 mild, 12-16 mild-to-moderate, 8-11 moderate, 5-7 severe.

map.1. 对获得和维持勃起有多大信心？（1–5 分）: 1. How much confidence do you have in getting and keeping an erection? (1-5)
map.2. 受到性刺激后，阴茎坚挺进入阴道的次数？（0–5 分）: 2. How often can you penetrate after sexual stimulation? (0-5 pts)
map.3. 性交时，阴茎进入阴道后维持勃起的次数？（0–5 分）: 3. How often can you maintain an erection during intercourse? (0-5 pts)
map.4. 性交时，维持勃起到性交完毕的困难程度？（0–5 分）: 4. How difficult is it to maintain an erection to completion? (0-5 pts)
map.5. 尝试性交时，感到满足的次数？（0–5 分）: 5. How often is intercourse satisfying? (0-5 pts)
map.评分基于过去6个月性生活情况。若近期无性生活（Q2–Q5 选\"0\"），评分参:
Scoring is based on sexual activity over the past 6 months. If there has been no recent sexual activity (choose '0' on Q2-Q5), the reference value of the score is limited.
ED causes include psychogenic, vascular, neurogenic, endocrine and drug-induced factors; a comprehensive assessment together with testosterone, blood glucose and lipid testing is recommended.
map.⚠️ 本评分仅供临床筛查参考，不能替代医师诊断。ED 可能是心血管疾病的早期信号: ⚠️ This score is for clinical screening reference only and cannot replace a physician's diagnosis. ED may be an early signal of cardiovascular disease and warrants a full evaluation.
map.📚 深度解析：IIEF-5 勃起功能评分: 📚 Deep dive: IIEF-5 erectile function score
map.5 项合计 14（轻中度 ED 12-16），勃起信心与维持均下降，建议 PDE: 5 items totaling 14 (mild-to-moderate ED 12-16); both erectile confidence and maintenance are reduced. PDE5 inhibitors are advised along with cardiovascular risk assessment.
map.合计 22（正常下限 22），性生活基本满意，可观察加生活方式干预。: Total 22 (lower limit of normal 22); sexual life is basically satisfactory, so observation plus lifestyle intervention is appropriate.
map.22-25 正常、17-21 轻度、12-16 轻中度、8-11 中度、5-7: 22-25 normal, 17-21 mild, 12-16 mild-to-moderate, 8-11 moderate, 5-7 severe; only Q2-Q5 may be 0 (no sexual activity).
map.IIEF-5 能区分心理性和器质性 ED 吗？: Can IIEF-5 distinguish psychogenic from organic ED?
map.单看总分不能。需结合夜间勃起（NPT）是否保留、有无晨勃、起病形式（突发多为心理: Not from the total score alone. It must be combined with whether nocturnal penile tumescence (NPT) is preserved, the presence of morning erections, the mode of onset (sudden suggests psychogenic, gradual suggests organic), and vascular risk factors such as diabetes, hypertension and dyslipidemia; vascular and endocrine testing is performed when necessary.
